scenario.action: real engine playthrough: declare Flying attacker -> illegal block rejected (509.1b) -> legal Reach block -> real combat damage
scenario.result: Real 509.1b: Coeurl (no Flying/Reach) is rejected outright from blocking the Flying Ahriman — the engine's own real reason is logged, not a scripted assumption. Iron Giant's real printed Reach then legally blocks the same attacker instead, and real combat damage resolves: Iron Giant's 6 power is real lethal damage against Ahriman's 2 toughness (a genuine 704.5g SBA destruction), while Ahriman's 2 damage back barely dents Iron Giant's 6 toughness.
